clues: This place sits on the Huron River in Michigan, in the north of the United States. It is the chief town of its zone, in the Great Lakes lands.
The Great Lakes shape the weather here in a clear way. In late fall and early winter, lake effect brings more clouds to its skies.
This town was founded in 1824 by settlers from the East Coast. It grew and was made a full city in the year 1851.
New tech firms flock to this town to feed on bright ideas. The big school here does deep research that draws them in.
This town is home to the University of Michigan, the oldest such school in the whole state. Its name is known far and wide.
